dlmf.title: NIST Digital Library of Mathematical Functions
dlmf.label: DLMF
dlmf.doc: Formulas, equations and figures by permalink, such as `5.4.E1`; see https://dlmf.nist.gov/help/cite.

kerodon.title: Kerodon
kerodon.label: Kerodon Tag
kerodon.doc: An online resource for homotopy-coherent mathematics, by Jacob Lurie. Each result has a tag of four digits or uppercase letters, such as `0X12`.

lmfdb.title: The L-functions and Modular Forms Database
lmfdb.label: LMFDB
lmfdb.doc: Knowls, the LMFDB's short definitions and explanations, by identifier: lowercase words, digits and underscores separated by periods, such as `group.abelian`.

pibase.topology.title: π-Base: Topology
pibase.topology.label: π-Base (Topology)
pibase.topology.doc: A community database of topological spaces, their properties and the theorems relating them. Properties are numbered like `P000001`, spaces like `S000001` and theorems like `T000001`.

stacks.title: The Stacks Project
stacks.label: Stacks Tag
stacks.doc: An open source textbook and reference work on algebraic stacks and the algebraic geometry needed to define them. Each result has a tag of four digits or uppercase letters, such as `0BR2`.

wikidata.title: Wikidata
wikidata.label: Wikidata
wikidata.doc: A free knowledge base. Each item has an identifier of the letter Q and digits, such as `Q42`.
